relationships.decision: Preserve separate job-level and workflow-level outcomes. Do not deduplicate either into a universal skipped-check result.
dimensions: evaluation unit: job versus whole workflow
native merge eligibility versus actual obligation execution
relationships.generalized_intent: Required-context status and verified execution evidence are different predicates. Assessment must retain the evaluation unit, exact target head, required-context inventory, trigger applicability and execution result.

scope: Source reconciliation only. No policy acceptance, native settings, workflow execution, approvals or rights clearance. Source expectations are pinned statements, not current runtime receipts.
